description: One node for Amazon.com: search products, the top 10 bestsellers in a category, one product's price and specs, or its reviews. Each action has a price. Use it when: A task needs Amazon: comparing what is for sale, seeing what sells best, checking a product's price and specs, or what buyers say. Not for: Other Amazon country stores, sellers' private data or placing orders. Returns: Depends on the action; see the actions table. Typical time: about 11 s. Actions: product (price, availability and details of one product; needs asin); reviews (customer reviews of one product; needs asin); search (10 search results for a query; needs query); bestsellers (top 10 bestsellers in a category; needs category). Price: from $0.007 per call, charged only on success. Price depends on action: product $0.007, reviews $0.014, search $0.055, bestsellers $0.069 (default product). One call = one Amazon action (search, bestsellers, product or reviews).

action.description: What to do; sets the price. product (needs asin), reviews (needs asin), search (needs query), bestsellers (needs category). Default product

asin.description: The 10-character Amazon product ID (ASIN), e.g. B0BSHF7WHW (for: product, reviews)

category.description: Category as in Amazon's best-seller URLs, e.g. electronics, books, kitchen, beauty (for: bestsellers)

query.description: What to look for, e.g. wireless earbuds (for: search)

name: amazon
title: Amazon data: search, bestsellers, reviews
